name: write-tab-inherits-bullet
request: Rewrite the tab from markdown: a heading and two plain paragraphs.
command:
sh -c "printf '# New title

First paragraph.

Second paragraph.
' > /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md && gdoc write --force --quiet --account {A} --tab 'Tab 1' {DOC} /tmp/gdt-micro-write.md"
expected: Tab holds exactly: HEADING_1 `New title`, then two NORMAL_TEXT paragraphs with no bullets.
target: heading `New title`, paragraph beginning `First paragraph`, paragraph beginning `Second paragraph`
allowed: revision list grows; renumber; lists map
